newsitem.title: CHINA: Nine killed in Shanghai-Nanjing highway pile-up.
newsitem.headline: Nine killed in Shanghai-Nanjing highway pile-up.

text.p: Nine people were killed and 12 injured in a 44-vehicle traffic pile-up on the new Shanghai-Nanjing highway, the Liberation Daily said on Monday.
The accident, which occurred on Sunday in heavy fog, is the most serious since the highway opened on September 15, the newspaper said.

The 274 km highway linking Shanghai and the city of Nanjing is one of the first freeways in east China and has been the scene of a series of accidents, apparently caused largely by drivers unfamiliar with high-speed driving techniques.
